ValidationRule.description: Prevents Sales users from creating non-upsell/cross-sell amendments within 120 days of the contract renewal date. Only Customer Operations can process amendments during this window.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Quote_Type__c, 'Amendment'), Within_Renewal_Window__c = TRUE, NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Amendment_Reason__c, 'Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Amendment_Reason__c, 'Cross-sell') ) ), NOT(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'Customer Ops')), NOT(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name, 'Operations')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This contract is within 120 days of renewal. Sales users cannot create downsell or cancellation amendments during this period. Please contact Customer Operations for assistance.
